human_goal: Terminar cuanto antes el circuito vivo de Prometeo y usar capacidad real para construirlo, no seguir haciendo laboratorio salvo fallo nuevo.

work_series.name: CHAT_VIVO
work_series.goal: Cerrar WC RETURN -> Primary Chat wake -> recover continuity -> integrate -> visible response -> next durable work -> allocator.

work_series.name: METRICAS_VIVAS
work_series.goal: Mantener una proyección rolling de última hora y visualización viva de workers, frontier, throughput, waits, context, branching, meta share, scale efficiency y human interruptions sin fake liveness.

work_series.name: CRECIMIENTO
work_series.goal: Ensachar el Work Graph con split/lookahead/fan-in para sostener capacidad útil de 10 WC y detectar el cuello causal real.

progress_frames.basis: productive_units_total / 60, where 60 = 10 workers x target 6; this is a campaign progress proxy, not product completion authority
progress_frames.on_threshold: Primary Chat should publish a concise visible checkpoint using durable evidence only: what changed, bottleneck, current metrics, next automatic action. Human reply not required.

truth_boundaries: Metrics are observability, never routing/CURRENT authority.
Missing measurement stays unknown, never invented zero.
No new scheduler, dealer, queue or parallel CURRENT.
No legacy Supabase write and no public raw private prompt text.
